data.coordinate_scale: Read coords.attrs.patch_size_level0 independently for every slide
data.missing_slide_policy: No substitution or zero filling; record unavailable original slide; use existing matched slides for that patient

aggregation.slide: Official encode_slide_from_patch_features on all available patches and original coordinates; no patch sampling
aggregation.patient_generic: Arithmetic mean of native slide embeddings, followed by L2 normalization
aggregation.patient_semantic: L2 normalize each official semantic slide representation, equal-weight average within patient, L2 normalize the average
aggregation.text: Official zero_shot_classifier template ensemble; normalize concept prototypes; verify source and official zero_shot score agreement

collapse_gate.primary: Covariance-spectrum entropy effective rank of patient-centered raw cosine scores

evaluation.preprocessing: StandardScaler and optional PCA fit within each inner training split, then refit outer training only
evaluation.OOF: Persist patient-level probabilities locally; concatenate all five outer tests separately for each seed before calculating metrics
evaluation.paired: Same patient folds for all models; seed-level paired concept-minus-generic differences; shared patient bootstrap of seed-mean OOF metric differences
evaluation.information_gate: At least one target has concept-minus-prior balanced accuracy >0 in all three seed OOF results and positive lower bound of a familywise 98.75-percent patient bootstrap interval
evaluation.interpretation: No concept selection or prompt revision from these targets; no survival outcomes; no claim that TNM prediction proves prognostic value or calibrated concept annotation

labels.T: T1/T2/T3/T4; map T4A/B to T4; TIS and TX excluded

storage.publish: Scripts, fixed configs and aggregate audit reports; no weights, H5, embeddings, patient labels or OOF patient predictions
